turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
A quick reminder: this lesson is about last weekend, so the actions are finished.
Watch me: on Sundays I watch TV. Last weekend is over, so I add -ed to watch: I watched TV last weekend.
The rule: for most verbs, add -ed to show the action is finished.
Right: He opened the door yesterday. Wrong: He open the door yesterday.
Now you. Write the past of "help":
Last Sunday I ___ my dad.
